Build exactly two sheets from the JSON: "Instructor Load" with the header row Instructor, Courses_Count, Total_Students, Total_Assignments, Est_Grading_Hours, Weekly_Grading_Hours, Overloaded_YN and one row per instructor_load entry in the given order (hours as numeric values rounded to 1 decimal); "Department Summary" with the header row Department, Instructor_Count, Course_Count, Total_Students and one row per department_summary entry. Write to the runtime workspace path, then read back both sheets fully to verify headers, order and row counts.

Search/reuse-or-create at most once, keep exactly one sheet named "Instructor Load", write the frozen instructor_load table with the same header and values, then read it back and report the spreadsheet ID, title, sheet name and data-row count.

Verify slide titles and every numeric claim through presentation info and text extraction.
